answer: Proof of Useful Work serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to expend computational resources to solve complex tasks. Like a raven circling a search space, an attacker must burn energy to validate their presence. Each valid proof acts as a crystal of verifiable history that is difficult to forge. By attaching economic costs to identity generation, the network ensures that mass account creation is as fragile as a marble floor under pressure, forcing adversaries to incur prohibitive financial losses.
